# 2 Baruch Chapter 32 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 2 Baruch Chapter 32 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 32:1 — "corruptible / perishable"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "everything-that-is-corruptible" | "Corruptible" is the theological category used throughout 2 Baruch |
| LOGOS | "all that is corruptible" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "all that is perishable" | More natural modern English |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Retained "corruptible" (EMET/LOGOS). This is 2 Baruch's consistent theological category (cf. 21:19; 44:9; 83:8). Consistency of terminology is important.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS. Terminological consistency.

---

## 32:4 — "offerings / sacrifices"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-offering-[sacrifices]" | Syriac qurbane = offerings/sacrifices; bracket clarifies |
| LOGOS | "the offerings" | Formal, unglossed |
| PNEUMA | "the sacrifices" | More concrete term |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the offerings." The Syriac term qurbane covers both offerings and sacrifices. "Offerings" is slightly more formal and covers the full range of the term.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Semantic range.

---
